long_biography.plain_text:
Rinat Akhmetov assembled SCM by moving from coal and coke trading into stakes in metallurgical plants, then combining mining and steel assets through vertical integration. Metinvest became the industrial core, while SCM also developed energy and other businesses under a common investment structure.

Akhmetov has owned and presided over Shakhtar Donetsk since 1996. He took over a club without its own stadium or training base, then funded an academy, facilities and international recruitment. Shakhtar broke Dynamo Kyiv's domestic dominance and won the UEFA Cup. His charitable foundation has supported cancer care, adoption reform and emergency aid.
